source.author: CDmir (Čestmír Dammer)
source.note: Wave-1 row 29 named the Quaternius animated chicken (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). The reachable Quaternius 'Chicken' (Textured Cute Monster Pack, OpenGameArt) was rendered and is a round big-eyed monster blob, not a farm chicken; no reachable Quaternius farm pack has one. This CC0 hen (license.txt in the zip: CC0, Čestmír Dammer) reads as a farm chicken at a glance and has idle, walk, eat, peck and death clips. Its .blend uses legacy Blender Internal materials, so the photo-derived texture is not read: body, beak and legs share one material (drawn as a white hen), the comb has its own. The sculpt base mesh ('Cylinder', a multires cage around the bird) is dropped. Height 0.4 m: a standing hen to the top of the comb.
